column11: Two filters from ZENITH High Proteinuria's entry criteria (NCT06087835: eGFR 20 to under 90, UACR above 700 mg/g). (1) eGFR 30 to 89 with UACR above 300 mg/g: 0.3% (G2), 0.3% (G3a) and 0.2% (G3b) of US adults against 14.8% with CKD (USRDS 2018 Annual Data Report, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Table 1.1(a), NHANES 2013 to 2016, niddk.nih.gov/-/media/Files/USRDS/2018-Previous-ADR/Volume-1/Chapter/v1_c01_genpop_18_usrds.pdf): 0.8 / 14.8 = 0.054054. (2) UACR above about 700 within those: FINE-REAL's finerenone starters had a median UACR of 292.7 mg/g and an upper quartile of 783.4 (Wheeler DC et al., Clin Kidney J 2025;18(11):sfaf305, doi:10.1093/ckj/sfaf305, 1,442 with a baseline value), so half sit above 293 and a quarter above 783, and half of those above 300 are taken to be above 700: 0.5, a judgement on a proxy. 0.054054 x 0.5 = 0.027027, about 1,000,000 of the book's 37mm
column12: The second share comes from people starting a kidney medicine rather than from the population, and 783 is above the trial's 700 floor, so the two lean opposite ways. eGFR 20 to 29 is left out because the USRDS cell runs 15 to 29 (0.15% of adults with UACR above 300), which leans low. Case for higher: AstraZeneca puts high proteinuria at 'approximately 10% of patients with CKD' (ZENITH-CKD press release, 2023-11-03, citing Murton M et al., Adv Ther 2021;38(1):180-200), which the USRDS table matches at 1.6 / 14.8 = 10.8% for every UACR above 300; if the label follows that rather than the trial's 700 floor the pool doubles. Case for lower: the trial also requires a stable maximum tolerated ACE inhibitor or ARB and excludes type 1 diabetes and recent heart failure admissions

column12: the 1.0 is the arguable figure. The free cash flow above is struck after it and the valuation already charges the debt by subtracting net debt, so the charge falls by that much, from 1.30% to 0.00%. Restated at replacement capex: AZN spent $6,095mm on plant over 2023 to 2025 against $2,411mm of plant depreciation, 2.32% of revenue above what keeps the plant running. Taken at depreciation, the charge stays nil. Restated with selling costs: SG&A now carries AZN's filed selling or distribution costs, 0.99% of revenue this charge was absorbing, so it falls from 0.00% to nil. The filed lines alone now leave less than the cash the company made before interest and at replacement capex, and a charge below nil would credit the book with cash its own costs do not leave. Checked without one-off cash: deal payments are booked under investing, so free cash flow never carried them, and no settlement or transition tax is stated for the window, so the charge stands. Restated to the amortisation floor: the filed cost lines leave a 22.75% pre-tax margin where the cash over 2023 to 2025 supports 27.47%, so the charge rebuilds at -4.72%. It was held at nil, but AZN books $4,207mm of non-cash amortisation of acquired intangibles inside its cost lines in FY2025 (0001104659-26-019130), 7.16% of revenue, so the charge takes the rebuilt figure: -4.72%. Checked without working capital build: no change in payables on file from the cash flow statement for every year, so the charge stands.
